objective: Mechanically enforce monotonic observation-horizon transitions across consecutive durable states without conflating horizon with useful-work evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Same canonical continuation verified before substantive work.
Reusable validator rejects a current trusted horizon older than previous durable trusted horizon.
Forward/equal transition remains valid when provenance is authentic.
Dedicated CI supplies previous durable state rather than checking only current provenance.
Integrated control-plane path is audited and receives the same transition semantics before objective closure.
checkpointable_substeps: Recover stale due forward and claim epoch 50.
Audit current validator for previous-state ordering enforcement.
Implement previous-state rollback rejection and regression coverage.
Wire parent horizon into dedicated workflow.
Observe CI and then extend integrated control-plane invocation if needed.
handoff_boundary: After each durable implementation/test/state mutation; never infer useful intervals from horizon provenance.
early_finish_fallback: Audit history edge cases such as initial state/no parent, merge commits, and equal-horizon idempotent transitions.
progress_evidence: No workflow run was yet observable for the workflow commit at checkpoint time; green is not claimed.
